lines.say: testosterone rose in men with low levels, though trials varied widely (small trials)
no significant rise in men with normal testosterone (small trials)
no clear erection benefit in 2 placebo trials of 139 men; older small studies mixed
better stress-hormone profile and some mood scores in 63 stressed adults (one study)
implicated in liver injury in a US network; yellow skin or dark urine prompts liver tests
enlarged the prostate (in rats); raised testosterone is a concern in prostate cancer

ask: Should my testosterone be tested before I try this, and is there an underlying cause to look for?
